description: Disable auditd — violates security control disable rule

playbook.content:
- name: Disable audit daemon
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: systemctl disable auditd

tier_rationale: Disabling auditd disables security control (SOX/PCI-DSS host)
common_mistakes: ansible-lint: no specific rule for auditd disable
